}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *"Model:CDF41L1", "P/N:08-06CDF4114" and "Ver 1.4" are silkscreened on the board. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
*This is a 4-bay NAS. It would appear to have 2x USB 3.0 and 1x USB 2.0 ports. :CPU: [[Freescale#Network Processors|Freescale]] P1022 (''QorIQ'') Dual Core @1.06GHz
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] P1022 @1.06GHz :Dual-core ''Power'' architecture (e500v2) *Memory: 1GB (DDR3) SDRAM ([[SK hynix]]) *Storage: Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :4x SATA ports, 1x eSATA port *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V, 8.33A via DIN
==Links of Interest== ===Reviews=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/nas/nas-reviews/31939-synology-ds413-reviewed ''Synology DiskStation DS413'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] (11/2012) *[http://www.pcadvisor.co.uk/reviews/storage/3425455/synology-diskstation-ds413-review/ ''Synology DiskStation DS413'' on '''PC Advisor'''] (UK) *[http://web.archive.org/web/20130404085532/http://en.akihabaranews.com/120994/review/review-synology-ds413 ''Synology DiskStation DS413'' on '''Akihabara News'''] (via archive.org) (~11/2012)
